x: Then two more "Valley" men, 12th and 16th, D. Patience for the "Cads" very close up, 17th, then J.
Three weeks later a similar fixture was held at Wimbledon over a five miles course, and ninety runners finished. First man home was Cohen (Ashcombe) with Footer (Belgrave) second, and J.
The Club 10 miles Championship was also gathered in by Footer, and again he won the sealed handicap, this time from the scratch mark. J.
